description: This file defines macros and inline functions for implementing and managing commit slabs, which are data structures used for memory or resource management related to commits.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab with a specified stride, setting size parameters and preparing it for use.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a slab with default stride of 1.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears the slab by freeing all allocated memory and resetting counters.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Deep clears the slab by applying a user-provided free function to each element before clearing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an element at a specific commit, optionally creating storage if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an element at a specific commit, creating if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an element at a specific commit without creating if missing.
